records.text: Randy Fine has repeatedly introduced bills to criminalize anti-Semitism, infringing upon free speech
records.speaker: Brett Cooper

appearances.snippet: He's repeatedly introduced bills to criminalize anti-Semitism, infringing upon free speech.

verification.notes: The episode and contemporaneous coverage confirm that Brett Cooper made this accusation. Fine sponsored or led multiple antisemitism-related measures, including a 2019 definition measure and later measures addressing antisemitic vandalism, flyers, and educational policy. However, describing all of them as bills to criminalize antisemitism is overbroad: some created or expanded penalties for specified conduct while others changed civil or education rules. Free-speech infringement is a contested legal and policy characterization, though civil-liberties critics did warn that the IHRA-based definition could chill protected political speech.
